svg.text: V-28 · CSR requirement diagram · personal data, decommissioning, vulnerabilities
CSR-C-14…CSR-C-16 of WP-S-07 §4: status, parent, allocation, shared safety mechanisms and cases
The device identity private key shall be readable only by the
processes that sign with it and shall not be exposed through any RPC, log or upload.
allocated SoC · verified by R, PT
Driver-facing video, cabin imagery and location logs shall be
encrypted at rest, or, if AGNOS cannot provide this, driver-camera recording shall be off by default and
allocated SoC; USR · verified by R, HIL
Any data upload shall use TLS with certificate validation to an
allocated SoC; ENV · verified by R, PT
Driver-camera video shall not be uploaded unless the owner opts
allocated SoC; USR · verified by R, PR
The decommissioning procedure shall erase user data and the
allocated USR; SoC · verified by PR, HIL
Decommissioning shall revoke the device's credentials at every
LionDriver endpoint and remove owner SSH keys.
allocated USR; ENV · verified by PR
LionDriver shall publish a security policy with a private reporting
allocated USR; ENV · verified by PR
Vulnerability analysis, incident response and update management
shall run per WP-O-05 from G6.
